title: GitLab security advisory (AV26-1210)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1210 Date: November 25, 2026 As of November 25, 2026, GitLab is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) Prior to 19.6.2 Prior to 19.5.9 Prior to 19.4.11 Prior to 19.3.10 Prior to 19.2.11 Prior to 19.1.11 Prior to 19.0.12 Prior to 18.11.15 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. GitLab Patch Release: 19.6.2, 19.5.9, 19.4.11, 19.3.10, 19.2.11, 19.1.11, 19.0.12, 18.11.15 GitLab release notes Article Link: GitLab security advisory (AV26-1210) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
